edges.reason: unlock() compares now against _lockTime, making ownership restoration dependent on block.timestamp.
lock() sets _lockTime = now + time, a timestamp-dependent ownership lock.
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender, an attacker-influenced authorization check.
unlock() reads _previousOwner to authorize and then restores it as owner.
sendETHToCharity executes external ETH transfers, providing an external call surface around state updates.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth which makes an external Uniswap call during a token transfer.
_transfer calls sendETHToCharity, an external value transfer, before completing internal accounting.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external Uniswap router swap which may call back into the token.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer reads msg.sender to enforce the blacklist check on the caller.
_transfer routes to _tokenTransfer to apply fee logic.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_transferStandard computes amounts via _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the charity portion via _takeCharity.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_takeCharity reads the current reflection rate via _getRate.
_getValues obtains the current rate via _getRate.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded balances from supplies, an arithmetic operation on state-derived values.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply results.
deliver computes reflection amounts via _getValues before burning reflections.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount using mul/div arithmetic.
manualSwap triggers the external Uniswap swapTokensForEth call.
manualSend triggers external ETH transfers via sendETHToCharity.
renounceOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable.
_transfer stores the contract token balance into the local variable used for swap decisions.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, an arithmetic state update.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router state variable to perform the swap.
sendETHToCharity reads the charity wallet address to transfer funds.
sendETHToCharity reads the marketing wallet address to transfer funds.
_reflectFee decrements the _rTotal reflection supply.
_setTaxFee is onlyOwner and writes the _taxFee state variable.
_setCharityFee is onlyOwner and writes the _charityFee state variable.
_setCharityWallet is onlyOwner and rewrites the charity payout address.
addBotToBlackList is onlyOwner and writes the _isBlackListedBot mapping controlling who may transfer.
excludeAccount is onlyOwner and writes the _isExcluded mapping altering reflection accounting.
The constructor sets the initial owner via the Ownable initialization.
deliver reads msg.sender as the account whose reflections are burned.
lock writes the _lockTime state variable that gates unlock authorization.
deliver consumes the caller-supplied tAmount parameter.
setMaxTxPercent consumes the maxTxPercent parameter.
lock consumes the time parameter for the lock duration.
addBotToBlackList consumes the account parameter.
_setCharityWallet consumes the charityWalletAddress parameter.
sendETHToCharity consumes the amount parameter to split transfers.
swapTokensForEth consumes the tokenAmount parameter for the router swap.

normalization_plan.reason: The tAmount parameter exists only to feed deliver; it should be folded into the deliver core function node.
The maxTxPercent parameter exists only to feed setMaxTxPercent and should be merged into that core function node.
The time parameter exists only to feed lock and should be merged into the lock core function node.
The account parameter exists only to feed addBotToBlackList and should be merged into that core function node.
The charityWalletAddress parameter exists only to feed _setCharityWallet and should be merged into that core function node.
The amount parameter exists only to feed sendETHToCharity and should be merged into that core function node.
The tokenAmount parameter exists only to feed swapTokensForEth and should be merged into that core function node.
The contractTokenBalance local variable is scoped to _transfer and should be merged into that core function node.
